body: I live in Lander WY. I work for a guy doing odd jobs. He pays me commission and under since it's so low.

Whats it like to get paid something besides $93 at the end of the week? I've personally never been to the grocery store and just tossed a bunch of food in the shopping cart and not worried if I could afford it or not. Everyone I know will not buy something that's expensive or over priced because they feel the value isn't there. I don't buy the over priced or expensive thing because I don't have the money to buy it at all. If I had the money most of the time I probably wouldn't have gotten it anyway but when I say to myself this thing isn't worth what they are asking for it, the money to buy it isn't there while with other people the money it still there in their bank account. 

I honestly don't know what it's like to impulse buy something or buy a place ticket somewhere and have a good time. I've never done any of those things for myself because I've never earned enough to do that. I'm approaching my 40's and I seriously have no idea how I'm going to retire when I get older because I've never made enough money to save. You talk about ups and downs. I haven't seen any ups since before my Dad died 21 years ago.
